description.en: Original Dicroidium-inspired preserved foliage-frond organ only, with a basal Y rachis and two coherent pinnule-bearing arms. One consistent entire oblong-lanceolate pinnule form is used throughout; nominal span and shallow three-dimensional relief are artistic. No fertile organ, whole parent plant, roots, mixed taxa, Umkomasia or Pteruchus added. The frozen brief pose contains an inherited fertile-fragment template phrase; it is explicitly inapplicable to this foliage-only model and metadata.
